subject.title: fix(hooks): report agent startup admission failures

question: Should `/hooks/agent` and mapped agent hooks change from the shipped immediate acknowledgement behavior to waiting up to 15 seconds for runner admission?
rationale: The change fixes false success but alters the public latency and retry contract for every deployed hook sender; repository tests cannot determine whether this operator-facing compatibility tradeoff is intended.

options.title: Approve admission-aware responses
options.body: Accept the synchronous wait after documenting the new timing and status contract and validating representative hook senders in a live Gateway.

options.title: Preserve immediate acknowledgement
options.body: Keep the shipped response timing and expose startup rejection through a separate durable status, callback, or polling contract.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it if maintainers do not want webhook acknowledgement coupled to runner-entry latency.

recommendation.title: Approve admission-aware responses
recommendation.body: Accept the synchronous wait after documenting the new timing and status contract and validating representative hook senders in a live Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the hook idempotency contract and has the strongest recent implementation history on the request-handler boundary being changed.
